name: Vishesh Samman Pension Yojana for the State Agitators who became Disabled and Completely Bedridden during the Uttarakhand State Movement
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a participant of the Uttarakhand Statehood Movement. 1. The applicant must have become permanently disabled and completely bedridden due to incidents during the Uttarakhand Statehood Movement.
